Cool, cool ...

... most corrupt Admin in American history.

And the most incompetent.

I really enjoyed this conversation with the wonderful @joycewhitevance.bsky.social. Please give it a listen and check out her book, "Giving Up Is Unforgivable: A Manual for Keeping a Democracy" podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/g...
Beowulf asks great questions and we got into these issues in depth!

“Critics raised alarm over the proposal to consolidate research stations while much of the Western United States is suffering from record temperatures and prolonged drought that increase the risk of wildfires this summer.” www.nytimes.com/2026/04/03/c...

This is what Trump's DOJ has been devoting resources too—appealing a federal judge's decision to release a 5 year old & his Dad, asylum seekers, from custody. Read here to find out what this DOJ isn't doing, so it can pursue Trump's political agenda. joycevance.substack.com/p/appealing-...

Also Macron, speaking for many, has this explanation: 
"When you want to be serious, you don’t go around saying the opposite every day of what you just said the day before. And perhaps you shouldn’t talk every day.”

There are a lot of Democrat-consultant types who believe that economics and prices are all that matter when it comes to public opinion. But this statistical analysis by @gelliottmorris.com tells a different story: economics, plus the unpopularity of Trump’s anti-immigrant agenda, plus other events.

“Trump could have found a reason to fire Bondi on virtually any day of her time in office. So it’s interesting that it happened on this particular timeline.” 

open.substack.com/pub/joycevan... by @joycewhitevance.bsky.social

As Hungarian elections approach phone calls obtained by reporters show Hungary’s foreign minister speaking deferentially to his Russian counterpart, promising to work to dilute European sanctions, revealing sensitive discussions, and complaining about EU leaders: www.occrp.org/en/scoop/hot...

Firing Pam Bondi doesn’t change the sweetheart deal Ghislaine Maxwell got in exchange for saying she never saw Trump doing anything wrong. For all we know, there’s a pardon or a commutation in the works, too. open.substack.com/pub/joycevan...

In wartime. 

“Hegseth asked Army Chief of Staff Gen. Randy George to step down & take immediate retirement…One of the sources said Hegseth wants someone in the role who will implement President Trump and Hegseth's vision for the Army.”
www.cbsnews.com/news/hegseth...
Pretty good guess here for why Bondi is gone: joycevance.substack.com/p/an-inadver...

Liam & his Dad came to this country seeking asylum, a fundamental human right that affords people fleeing persecution or danger the right to request protection in another country. Protecting their rights seems essential to ensuring we keep our own. open.substack.com/pub/joycevan...

Birthright citizenship isn’t a close call—it’s settled constitutional law. Today’s oral argument made that clear, even as the stakes remain enormous. Here’s what mattered and what comes next. 
open.substack.com/pub/joycevan...

This morning SG Sauer argued “Unrestricted birthright citizenship” contradicts the practice in other countries. But conservatives on the Court have a long history of rejecting any reference to foreign law, for instance, on the death penalty. What’s next, imposing Sharia law?

We’ve been asking what the cost of Trump’s insistence on doing immigration cases involving law abiding hardworking people is. Now, @propublica.org has documented it. We are not safer or better off. www.propublica.org/article/trum...
